title: Delicious Dutch Pancake Recipe
description: A classic Dutch pancake recipe made with simple ingredients and perfect for a weekend breakfast. This pancake is fluffy and delicious, great for topping with your favorite fruits and syrups.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and a pinch of salt.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, eggs, milk, and vanilla extract.
3. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until smooth.
4. Heat a 12-inch non-stick skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat.
5. Pour about 1/2 cup of the batter into the skillet and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
6. Cook for about 2-3 minutes or until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
7. Loosen the pancake with a spatula and slide it onto a plate.
8. Repeat with the remaining batter, greasing the skillet with butter as needed.
9. Serve the pancake hot with your favorite toppings, such as fruits, whipped cream, or syrup.
